structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Requirements for licensure as a physical therapist assistant
law.text:
An applicant for licensure as a physical therapist assistant shall submit evidence, verified by affidavit and satisfactory to the Board, that the applicant:
Is 18 years of age or more;
Is a graduate of a two-year educational program for physical therapist assistants at an institution of higher education that is acceptable to the Board; and
Has satisfactorily passed an examination approved by the Board.
